name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task states only ‘If you move the ball, you must also take the key’ and ‘pick up the box in the other room’. Existence(target_picked_up) hard is correct. The hard Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) is an added requirement – the task never says the box must be picked up only after acquiring the key; the ordering is guaranteed by the environment and is not stated by the task. The hard Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up) is also added – the task does not require the target pickup to follow a blocker move, only an unconditional pickup. Remove the added Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) and the added Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up); keep the RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) hard for the conditional and the hard Existence(target_picked_up) for the unconditional goal.

texts: If the blocker is moved, the door key must also be acquired at some point
Eventually pick up the target box
